text: {"danger_level":"green","danger_reason":"You are currently beyond the outdoor evacuation distance for a Pipe bomb (5 lb TNT eq.).","main_move":"STAY_ALERT","main_move_text":"Stay alert and follow official updates","where_to_go":"Stay where you are and maintain awareness of your surroundings.","do_now":[{"text":"Remain in this preferred area beyond the outdoor evacuation line.","advice_ids":["exp.green_area"]},{"text":"Move out of line of sight of the incident scene.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"text":"Stay cautious as evacuation distances do not guarantee absolute safety.","advice_ids":["exp.no_guarantee"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not approach the source or enter the danger zone.","advice_ids":["exp.no_guarantee"]},{"text":"Do not gather near windows or doorways to view the incident, as secondary devices could pose a risk.","advice_ids":["exp.secondary","exp.line_of_sight"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"Indoors near windows","text":"Move away from windows and out of line of sight of the scene.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"situation":"In a building or shelter","text":"Remain in the preferred area beyond the building evacuation line.","advice_ids":["exp.green_area"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Zone limits come from an official bomb chart distance table and there is only one data gap.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Bomb stand-off distances are estimates based on test data; the chart states they do not guarantee safety and that the area near the evacuation distances is still potentially dangerous.","Building distances assume typical US commercial construction; Indian buildings may perform differently."],"valid_while":[]}
